infotexts.ng.fix1.name: Container optimization
infotexts.ng.fix1.tip: Skip per-frame processing of already-spent insert-effects on items inside containers (per-round-reload guns etc.). Turn it off to compare the load.
infotexts.ng.fix2.name: Nearby-item search optimization
infotexts.ng.fix2.tip: Skip scanning the whole world for nearby items when no matching item exists (PDA, various guns). Turn it off to compare the load.
infotexts.ng.fix3.name: Auto-tool throttling
infotexts.ng.fix3.tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Run auto-triggered RepairTool tools (sprinklers etc.) less often (≈half the tickrate), accumulating time — extinguish/water power is preserved, but raycasts/particles run less = lower load. Turn off if anything looks off.
infotexts.ng.tip.client: Enable/disable the fix on YOUR client (your FPS). Affects only you.
infotexts.ng.tip.serverhost: Enable/disable the fix on the SERVER (server CPU). Only the host/admin can change it — others see the state only.
infotexts.ng.tip.servermponly: The server toggle is available in multiplayer only.
infotexts.ng.tip.serverbench: Run a benchmark ON THE SERVER (host/admin only): measures the server update rate and the top items/mods loading the server CPU. The report appears in this window.
infotexts.ng.tip.serversnap: Request an INSTANT server-load snapshot (update rate, ms/tick, item/body/character counts) — no 60s run. Host/admin only.
infotexts.ng.tip.duration: Benchmark duration (client and server). Click to cycle: 15s / 30s / 1min / 5min.
infotexts.ng.tip.info: Hover for a detailed description of this fix.
